messages:
Tess (Partnerships): Aerolith PO failed ingestion. Vendor uploaded EUR-denominated PO but marketplace expects USD for this partner record; portal also flagged VAT number mismatch (submitted VAT GB12345 vs registered VAT GB54321). Need a quick path to unblock EU demo and invoices. @Anil?
Anil (Procurement): Portal rejects on currency and VAT mismatch. We require corrected PO with matching VAT or an EU VAT attestation + B2B invoice preference. Can't map vendor if currency doesn't match vendor registration.
marketplace-bot: ingestion -> REJECTED {"ticket":"MP-31221","reasons":["currency_mismatch","vat_mismatch"]}
Ivy (CSM): Aerolith says their EMEA ops accidentally used the UK sales template (GBP/EUR) but their marketplace record is USD. They can reissue a USD PO but earliest is Monday regional finance. They offered a signed VAT reconciliation letter and a temporary currency override request.
Ben (Finance): I can create a provisional ledger mapping for EUR invoices (LEDG-AERO-EUR) but payouts will be delayed until VAT reconciles. For VAT mismatch I need either: corrected VAT on PO, official VAT registration docs, or a legalized attestation linking numbers.
Rosa (Legal): Low-risk temporary path: vendor signs a VAT attestation that names both VAT numbers and confirms which entity will invoice and accept currency risk, plus commitment to cure within 7 days. I'll prepare a 1-paragraph attestation template. DocuSign preferred.
Marco (Sales): We're in a co-demo with a top prospect Thurs EMEA. If we can get a signed attestation + provisional EUR ledger mapped, can Partnerships flip the integration to "demo_enabled"? Sales needs 24h SLA to avoid rescheduling.
Anil (Procurement): If Legal posts attestation and vendor signs, Procurement can mark ticket MP-31221 as PROVISIONAL_ACCEPT for 5 business days. Currency override allowed for demo only. No invoicing until Finance clears VAT docs.
Aerolith AE: Looping in Aerolith EMEA finance. They committed to send DocuSign attestation within 18 hours and will attempt an updated USD PO by Monday. Request: can you accept scanned attestation if DocuSign blocked?
Rosa (Legal): Scanned attestation OK only if notarized and includes signatory authority language. DocuSign strongly preferred. I'll upload template to MP-31221 now.
Ben (Finance): Upon attestation attachment I'll create LEDG-AERO-EUR and set payment_status=HOLD. Notify me in thread when signed.
Tess (Partnerships): Action items: 1) Rosa to post attestation template, 2) Aerolith AE to secure DocuSign, 3) Ben to create provisional ledger on attach, 4) Anil to set PROVISIONAL_ACCEPT in portal. If attestation not signed within 18h, Sales to consider rescheduling demo.
marketplace-bot: ticket update -> MP-31221 status: AWAITING_ATTestation.
Ivy (CSM): Pushing vendor now, flagged "demo window". Will update once DocuSign complete. :pray:
